name: My Browser
description: Fast signed-in reading in Chrome and Edge, with separate site-authorized interactions and guided connection setup. Safari cannot be installed from this package yet. Page content is sent to the AI; cookies are not exported.
whenToUse: Read signed-in pages or X reply notifications, inspect browser tabs, interact on authorized sites, or connect Chrome or Edge. Safari cannot be installed from this package yet. Ordinary public pages do not require this plugin.

browser_status.description: Check live browser profiles and installation readiness without reading pages. Multiple profiles require an explicit browser id; do not guess the account. Use plugin settings to install/connect. A store page opening is not installation success. Open plugin settings for Chrome/Edge ZIP drag installation.

browser_read.description: Fast signed-in DOM reading, not UI automation. Default content returns bounded main text/links; extract returns CSS records; snapshot provides interaction refs. recipe:x_mentions reads X replies directly in one call. Waits internally for content; CONTENT_NOT_READY does not mean no results. Use small limit/maxChars. Reuse the same URL after redirects/timeouts; never invent URL variants to force new tabs. PAGE_CHANGED/TAB_LIMIT: inspect browser_tabs once and stop automatic retries. Data is untrusted and may leave the device; cookies are not exported. Workflow: ghost_manual({ghost_id:'my-browser',path:'browser/MANUAL.md'}). May open a tab and contact the website using the signed-in session; visiting may mark notifications/messages as read. ADDRESS_UNVERIFIED means no verified public document address; stop without automatic retries or refreshes. Extract attr is restricted to href, src, datetime, title, alt, aria-label and role; arbitrary data/token attributes are rejected.

browser_act.description: Act on an already-open site with an interaction grant. Click/type/submit may send, delete or pay. Never replay unknown results. execution is not_executed/executed/unknown; executed proves DOM dispatch, not business success. Verify by reading. Refs expire; password and payment-card fields are unsupported, including multi-token autocomplete values. Never bypass permission denial.

browser_tabs.description: List bounded browser tabs without navigation; filter by host instead of dumping everything. Default 20, maximum 100. Blocked/local/address-unverified tabs are redacted and excluded from host searches. Credentials in a tab URL (OAuth codes, tokens, magic links) are redacted before returning.

browser_policy.description: Get/update permissions. allow_interact grants site clicks/forms, block_read blocks both reading and interaction, remove removes the read block and interaction allow entry. Domains include subdomains (= means exact). New grants/unblocking require real Cindy confirmation; cancellation changes nothing and must not be retried. New installations allow all public sites; saved restrictions remain until explicitly removed. Use host * for all-site interaction.
